segments.ja316:1.1: Satta me rohitā macchā, udakā thalamubbhatā;
segments.ja316:1.3: Idaṃ brāhmaṇa me atthi, etaṃ bhutvā vane vasa.
segments.ja316:2.3: Maṃsasūlā ca dve godhā, ekañca dadhivārakaṃ;
segments.ja316:2.5: Idaṃ brāhmaṇa me atthi, etaṃ bhutvā vane vasa.
segments.ja316:3.1: Ambapakkaṃ dakaṃ [ambapakkodakaṃ (sī. pī.)] sītaṃ, sītacchāyā manoramā [sītacchāyaṃ manoramaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja316:3.3: Idaṃ brāhmaṇa me atthi, etaṃ bhutvā vane vasa.
segments.ja316:4.1: Na sasassa tilā atthi, na muggā napi taṇḍulā;
segments.ja316:4.3: Iminā agginā pakkaṃ, mamaṃ [maṃsaṃ (ka.)] bhutvā vane vasāti.
